basis: Implementation-side source inspection bound to bytes; not independent financial or OS admission.

entries.rationale: Loopback WebSocket load against locally constructed App Server synthetic handlers; does not send model inference or attest a paid 8h/24h run.
Authenticated POST to registered production evidence collectors can trigger collector work. Operator authority and any remote costs are outside the Chat budget contract.

Standalone paid calibration probe uses injected/raw fetch. CLI and exported runner reject formal scope before config/options or dispatch; ordinary diagnostics require separate authorization and are not formal samples.
Bounded public artifact GET with validated redirects and integrity checks. Downloading a release does not publish it or admit model execution.
Marketplace fixture includes a generic CONNECT proxy and configured test destinations. Classification does not constrain arbitrary proxy destinations or confer a billing contract.
Opt-in public package metadata GET from npm/Open VSX. Default local snapshot does not perform public readback; visibility is not release qualification.
Paid model/tool/compaction diagnostic intercepts global fetch and estimates usage. Formal scope rejects before config, receipts, environment or fetch mutation. Estimate stops are not hard limits.
Synthetic loopback MCP/OAuth/TLS fixtures with injected HTTP wrappers. Does not prove containment of production MCP servers, delegated tools or their costs.
Local MCP reference fixture forwards to a loopback child server. Production tool delegation and descendant costs remain separate boundaries.
Paid connectivity probe; import is inert and runner rejects formal scope before CLI/config. Ordinary CLI requires explicit live confirmation; estimated cost is not a quota.
Authenticated bounded GitHub Actions Jobs API GET for exact run/attempt evidence. Does not dispatch jobs or prove downstream billing coverage.
GitHub checks/status readback. API responses are evidence inputs, not publication or financial admission.
Bounded registry artifact download and toolchain preparation; no provider inference. Artifact identity and native admission are independently checked.

HTTPS model diagnostic rewrites thinking/output policy and estimates CNY usage. Formal scope rejects creation, beginTask and direct dispatch. An externally running IPC/network broker is not contained by AsyncLocalStorage.

limitations: Async-local scope cannot propagate across IPC/HTTP or arbitrary descendants.
A broker created and assigned outside the scope remains uncontained by the caller scope.
Static categories do not imply zero service cost or authorize remote collection work.
